svg.title: ScienceGuru GPT-2 research workflow and completed experiments
svg.desc: Five workflow stages: survey, size the MLP, schedule training, execute, verify. nc027: MLP width 5120, 9873 updates, 73.377287 minutes, CORE 0.258965; nc029: MLP width 5120, 9841 updates, 73.497218 minutes, CORE 0.263907; nc033: MLP width 4864, 9841 updates, 72.241873 minutes, CORE 0.259212. Each is one seed 42 run. At 9841 updates, nc033 took 75.32 seconds less than nc029; CORE decreased but stayed above the target. The training-time axis starts at zero.
